title: The Museum of Fatigue
overview: an AI-generated artwork directed by Jhonattan Sarmiento, combining stop motion aesthetics, tactile textures, and immersive sound design to explore human fragility in times dominated by machines, acceleration, and repetition. The audiovisual piece unfolds in three distinct moments, arranged as halls within the museum, each inviting the viewer to observe, pause, and reflect on different dimensions of modern exhaustion.
